capabilities: Convert selected text between Ukrainian and English keyboard layouts
Auto-detect conversion direction from Cyrillic vs Latin characters
Convert the word under the cursor when nothing is selected
disambiguation: Not a keyboard layout switcher or input tool; it only rewrites already-typed text, not your system layout or input language.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Words typed in the wrong keyboard layout come out garbled, and fixing them usually means switching system layout, retyping or undoing.
summary: Keyboard layout fixer that converts selected text between English and Ukrainian layouts when typed in the wrong one.
